annotations.title: Bind an Ahrefs project to a MisarSEO project

description: Bind (or repoint) ONE of a project's two independent Ahrefs project types — `projectType` selects `rank_tracker` or `site_audit`. `ahrefsProjectId` is re-validated against the caller's LIVE project list on every call — fails if the project fell out of the connected account's access since it was last listed via list_ahrefs_projects.

ahrefsProjectId.description: Ahrefs' own project id, taken verbatim from list_ahrefs_projects.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

projectType.description: Which of the two independent Ahrefs project types to bind.

name: set_ahrefs_project
